definition.scope: Additional sampled access diagnostics, never replace v1 fixed-target results or count samples as independent subjects.
definition.face_interval_rule: Shrink along-face center interval by body half-width. When object is narrower than body, use face midpoint instead of declaring impossible; actual body collision still checked. Deduplicate coincident points.
definition.meaning: Reachable portion of prescribed sampled approach locations; no drawer operation, sitting, light or physical use label.

scope: Additive diagnostic beside legacy fixed points. Any reachable sample is not an activity pass; all samples passing is still not actual ergonomic/door/drawer/seating validation.
